object.body:
Dear $requesterName,


You recently requested access to #set($sep="")#foreach($item in $accessRequestItems.split(","))$sep$item.trim()#set($sep=", ")#end. We weren't able to send it to your approver yet because of a separation of duties (SoD) conflict.

Some combinations of access aren't allowed under your company's security policy. This is called an SoD rule — it's designed to prevent one person from having too much control over a sensitive process.

Request Details

  • Request by: $accessRequestDetails.requestBy
  • Requested for: $accessRequestDetails.requestedFor
  • Date: $accessRequestDetails.date

Return to SailPoint to view more details.

Review your request


Thank you,
The $__global.productName Team
object.description: Sent to the identity a request was made for when their access request cannot be forwarded to an approver because of a separation of duties (SoD) conflict.
